lockBar.title: Plan locked {time} — changes only through a revision with a reason

cantLock.title: Can't lock yet — required checklist items are missing
cantLock.body: Tick the items with a red border in the checklist, then lock the plan
cantLock.hint: Tick every required checklist item before locking

fields.validUntilHelp: Empty = end of the plan day

calc.waiting: Enter entry, stop loss and risk % to size the position

management.none: This setup has no management rules

checklist.empty: This setup has no checklist yet
checklist.frozen: Answers were locked with the plan

emotion.closed: Can be logged until the entry

revisions.empty: No revisions yet — locking the plan records rev 1 with its hash

revisionSheet.title: New revision {n}
revisionSheet.afterEntryBody: This revision counts as a deviation and shows in the timeline
revisionSheet.riskFixed: After the entry the risk % is fixed — move the SL / TP instead

status.dialogBody: A reason is always required — it helps the review explain why the plan wasn't traded
status.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. CPI release too close to the entry
status.deleteBody: The draft is deleted for good. Locked plans can't be deleted.

terminal.title: This plan is {status} — read only
terminal.closed: The trade of this plan is closed

notFound.title: Plan not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or belong to another user

plans.noAccount: Create a trading account before planning
plans.noSetup: Create a setup in the Playbook before planning

errors.slBelowEntry: LONG: stop loss must be below the entry
errors.slAboveEntry: SHORT: stop loss must be above the entry
errors.tpAboveEntry: LONG: TP must be above the entry
errors.tpBelowEntry: SHORT: TP must be below the entry
errors.tpRequired: Add at least one take profit
errors.tpShareOver: TP shares add up to more than 100%
errors.riskRange: Risk must be above 0 and at most 10%
errors.form: The plan is incomplete — check the fields with a red border
errors.stop_loss_wrong_side: Stop loss is on the wrong side of the entry
errors.take_profit_wrong_side: A take profit is on the wrong side of the entry
errors.take_profit_pct_over_100: TP shares add up to more than 100%
errors.conversion_rate_required: This symbol needs a conversion rate to the account currency — can't size it yet
errors.setup_archived: This setup is archived — choose another one
errors.symbol_mismatch: The plan's symbol must match the analysis
errors.plan_not_draft: This plan is already locked — reload the page
errors.plan_not_revisable: This plan can't take revisions any more
errors.plan_closed: Pre-trade emotion can only be logged before the entry
errors.invalid_transition: That status change isn't allowed from the current status
errors.risk_pct_after_entry: After the entry the risk % is fixed — move the SL / TP instead
errors.valid_until_passed: Valid-until has passed — extend it before locking
errors.validation: Some values are invalid — check the form
errors.network: Can't reach the server — try again
